turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail: saidHow long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?Agent saidOrders placed Monday-Friday before the cutoff time usually ship the same business day. If you ordered after the cutoff or during a weekend or holiday, your order ships the next business day. Tracking is sent once your order ships, but it can take 24-48 hours for the carrier to update tracking. During busy periods, allow 1-2 extra business days for processing. Are you asking about a US order or an international order?
